Unique θ fixed by α^3 is odd because S8 has no element order nine; exact 28- and 36-point cycles follow. The symmetric determinant correspondence and trivial finite-field Brauer obstruction yield the degree 1/3/9 count. Standalone C++ checks exhaust 1,451,520 symplectic elements and all F19 rational lines, corroborating but not substituting the infinite argument.
